_comment: THE single owner of which plugins are enabled. equicord-overrides.json carries per-plugin options only; its enabled flags are ignored by the writer. Manifest required=true plugins and manifest-described dependencies are added on top of this list at apply time. v2 adds DisableCallIdle (no alone-in-voice auto-disconnect), SearchFix (works around Discord's broken search), and OnePingPerDM (collapses rapid DM ping spam) - all three sat fully configured in the overrides file while this policy switched them straight back off on every apply.
